comment: Castrum Meridianum's BNpcBase 14571: what it did in three retail runs (Connor's Chronofoil capture af05916c (2026-11-09, visit 0.8) and Bob's 9ba7d981 (visit 0.12) and 50e72631 (visit 0.3) of 2026-11-17, all with Duty Support; `questkit sources --duty 15`: its rotation's pace and each action's median amounts). A draft from Bob's Chronofoil captures (50e72631, 9ba7d981, af05916c), not yet checked in game: ContentFinderCondition 15, BNpcBase 14571, BNpcName 2108, level 50, 7663 HP, 9 seen in 3 runs. `players` and `npcs` are the median damage to each, `every` the median time between uses.

actions.comment: 3 uses; 2.7 s cast. Retail (questkit rates, 2026-11-21: 10 casts by 8 of the duty fixtures' NPCs): first 37.7 s after the pull (median; earliest 11.2 s), `every` 51 s (the median of 2 times between one's uses); used by 8 of the 14 that fought past then (`chance` 0.57). Before, the rotation would have cast it 153 times at most over lives retail's cast it 10.
